question_text: A 3-year-old male is evaluated for frequent nose bleeds. Physical examination shows diffuse petechiae on the patient’s distal extremities. Peripheral blood smear shows an absence of platelet clumping. An ELISA binding assay reveals that platelet surfaces are deficient in GpIIb/IIIa receptors. Which of the following anticoagulants pharmacologically mimics this condition?
